def solve():
    KE = Q("12.5")
    FE = Q("5.5")
    ke_f = KE / (1 - FE / 100)
    D = Q(180)
    KD = Q("6.25")
    I = D * KD / 100
    cap = Q("0.3") * 115
    ded = min(I, cap)
    T = Q(29)
    atkd = KD * (1 - (T / 100) * (ded / I))
    wD = Q("0.2")
    wE = 1 - wD
    wacc = wE * ke_f + wD * atkd
    return {
        "final": wacc,
        "flotation_adjusted_equity_cost_percent": ke_f,
        "deductible_interest": ded,
        "after_tax_debt_cost_percent": atkd,
    }
